missions.title: The Red House Delivery
missions.short: Deliver 3 apples to the RED HOUSE.
missions.goal: Take exactly three apples from the marked market crate to RED HOUSE.
hints: Find the apples at the market.
Pick up three red apples from the marked crate.
Follow the glowing path to RED HOUSE.

missions.title: Workshop Supplies
missions.short: Take 5 wood and 3 stones to the WORKSHOP.
missions.goal: Collect five logs from grove and three stones from stone patch; submit all eight at workshop.
hints: The workshop needs wood and stone.
Find five logs in the grove and three stones near the rocks.
Bring all eight objects to the workshop sign.

missions.title: Build the Bridge
missions.short: Make the bridge with 3 supports and 4 planks.
missions.goal: Snap three supports into lower sockets, then four planks across bridge upper sockets.
hints: The bridge needs supports first.
Place three square supports into the lower glowing spaces.
Now add four long planks to cross the water.

missions.title: Market Basket
missions.short: Buy 2 bread and 1 milk for TOWN HALL.
missions.goal: Use separate 12-coin job budget: 2 bread costing 3 each + 1 milk costing 4; total 10, change 2; deliver to Town Hall.
hints: Read the list at the market.
Choose two bread and one milk. Watch the total.
You should spend ten of the twelve job coins.

missions.title: Village Road Rally
missions.goal: Drive through all four wide checkpoint arches in order; elapsed time only for optional reward.
hints: Follow the bridge to the meadow course.
Drive the yellow van through gate 1, then 2, then 3, then 4.
You can finish as slowly as you like.

missions.title: Two-Stop Post
missions.short: Deliver two BLUE parcels and one ORANGE parcel.
missions.goal: Deliver 2 blue parcels to Red House and 1 orange parcel to Workshop, with clear address labels.
hints: Collect the parcels at the post counter.
BLUE goes to RED HOUSE. ORANGE goes to WORKSHOP.
Check both address labels before dropping off.

missions.title: Fix the Swings
missions.short: Build 2 swings with 4 ropes and 2 seats.
missions.goal: Use 4 rope pieces and 2 seats on two swing frames. Both swings function after completion.
hints: Each swing uses two ropes and one seat.
Two swings need four ropes and two seats.
Snap each part into the highlighted frame.

missions.title: Park Planner
missions.short: Decorate the green with 20 job coins.
missions.goal: Choose and place a bench, flowerbed and lamp for 6+4+9=19 from a dedicated budget of 20; change 1.
hints: The park has twenty coins to spend.
Bench costs six, flowers four, lamp nine.
Place each item inside the green outline. You should have one coin left.

missions.title: Race the Clock (Bonus)
missions.short: Finish the course; 75 seconds is a bonus challenge.
missions.goal: Complete the four checkpoint course; optional 75-second goal for bonus coins; time never prevents job completion.
hints: Complete the course in any time.
Look for the broad alternate road through the meadow.
Finish under 75 seconds only if you want the extra bonus.

missions.title: Home Sweet Home
missions.short: Furnish your house: table, 2 chairs and plant.
missions.goal: Buy and snap one table at 8, two chairs at 5 each, one plant at 3; total cost 21 from owned coins, with free basic furniture fallback if necessary.
hints: Visit the house and open the furnishing menu.
Place one table, two chairs and a plant.
You can move furniture after placing it.
